item.neant.neant_chestplate.desc: Nothing crosses the void that protects you.
item.neant.neant_boots.desc: The ground is merely a suggestion.
tooltip.neant.set1: • Void Aura: burns and pulls everything within 6 blocks
tooltip.neant.set2: • Bulldozer sprint: crush everything in your path
tooltip.neant.set3: • Immune to fall and void damage (the Void brings you back)
item.neant.neant_sword.desc1: Every hit tears the Void open and pulls nearby enemies in.
item.neant.neant_sword.desc2: Right click: fires a blade wave that slices the terrain for 36 blocks.
item.neant.neant_pickaxe.desc1: Mines a 5×5×3 area in one swing (Sneak: disabled).
item.neant.neant_pickaxe.desc2: Right click: the Drill bores a 46-block tunnel.
item.neant.neant_shovel.desc1: Erases all connected sand, dirt and gravel at once.
item.neant.neant_shovel.desc2: Right click: opens a Black Hole that devours everything.
item.neant.neant_axe.desc1: Fells an entire tree, leaves included, in one hit.
item.neant.neant_axe.desc2: Right click: Blade Whirlwind slices everything around you.
item.neant.neant_lighter.desc1: Click a block or the air: a Void Fire Wave.
item.neant.neant_lighter.desc2: Ignites everything and detonates TNT in its path.
message.neant.forge.help: Throw the base item (diamond gear or flint and steel) and Void Shards onto the forge, then right click.
message.neant.forge.missing: You need %1$s Void Shards to forge this (%2$s on the forge). Item: %3$s
message.neant.rift.open: A Void Rift is tearing open in the sky...
message.neant.rift.guardian: The Void Guardian has emerged from the rift!
message.neant.rift.closed: The rift closes. The Void calms.
